verdict: EXTERNAL (MIMIC-IV ICU, 15949 norepi stays): REPLICATES -- reliability 0.947 [0.944, 0.95]; early->late 0.617 [0.605, 0.628]. Requirement->mortality age-adjusted OR 3.798 [3.441, 4.174] (AUC +0.2051 over age). Independent ICU population (critical-illness vasoplegia) + hard endpoint + real timestamps -> strong generalisation of the requirement concept. Does NOT validate the arterial-waveform tone estimator (needs MIMIC-IV-Waveform).
